editorial.blurb: A casual yet cozy Korean-American spot near Wrigleyville where delightful staff and an extensive menu of flavorful dishes—from bibimbap to galbi burgers—keep people coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for breakfast or brunch, grab a table overlooking Clark Street for people-watching, and don't miss the Kim Ma Ri if it's available—it's a standout that keeps regulars returning.
